name: Anderson-Morley sharp curvature ceiling for a graph Laplacian eigenpair (witness form over Q)

statement.latest: \forall (\lambda, x) \text{ an exact node-pair witness of } L_R x=\lambda x,\ \exists (u,v)\in E:\ |\lambda|\le \deg u+\deg v.\quad \text{Corollary (curvature floor } F_{\min}\text{): } \lambda \le 4-F_{\min}
statement.note_ascii: for any exact eigenpair (lam,x) there is an edge (u,v) with Qabs(lam) <= deg(u)+deg(v); under a curvature floor Fmin, lam <= 4 - Fmin (a factor sqrt(2) tighter than the 2*dmax route)
